Hi Emily — thanks for the clear checklist and the intake form. Looping in Laura (AP) and Ben (Compliance) to help with PO and security items.

Quick answers and next steps:

1) DPA: attached is a redline of our standard DPA (file: CobaltWorks_DPA_redline.pdf). Ben, please review the redline for any compliance notes (cc'd). We can do a DocuSign execution once legal confirms; typical turnaround is 3–5 business days after redline acceptance.

2) SOC 2: here's a secure link to our latest SOC 2 Type II report (access-limited): https://drive.redwood.ai/soc2/Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf — please let me know if you need a read-only view or an NDA prior to access.

3) Subprocessors: attached CSV contains our current subprocessor roster (file: Redwood_subprocessor_list.csv). If CobaltWorks has particular blocked vendors, flag them and Ben will escalate.

4) PO & invoicing: Laura — can you confirm our PO acceptance requirements? For CobaltWorks: we normally require the PO number on the invoice, remit-to: Redwood Inc., and that invoices be sent to invoices@redwood.ai. We do accept emailed PDFs; e-invoicing (Peppol/SFTP) is treated case-by-case — Laura, I'll let you confirm.

Action items for Emily: please confirm the billing contact, remit address, and whether CobaltWorks requires any special data-retention clauses in the DPA (e.g., UK/EU data residency conditions). Once we have that, we'll proceed with the DPA sign and generate PO guidance.

Best,

Hi Emily / Chloe — Laura from AP here. Quick notes on PO and invoicing flow so you can proceed:

- To generate a PO we need: a completed vendor intake form (we have), a completed W-9 (or local equivalent) — Emily, please share if applicable, and a signed DPA (can be DocuSigned).
- Please have invoices sent to invoices@cobaltworks.com and include the Redwood PO number in the invoice header (we will provide the PO number once the DPA and vendor registration are complete).
- Invoices should list line-level descriptions and match the amounts on the PO exactly to avoid delays. Our AP team processes invoices net 30 from date of PO acceptance.

If CobaltWorks prefers to receive a preliminary PO ID for testing e-invoice integration, we can issue a "PO TEST-000" placeholder once vendor registration is underway — final PO will be issued after DPA execution.

Ben will follow up on the DPA redline items that touch on subprocessors / restricted transfers. Jonas, adding you as legal may need to review clause 6.

Thanks — happy to sync on a short call if that helps accelerate.
